name: MKT_IMP_OBJECT_DETAILS
description: This table stores the VOs contained in the registered application module for the import object.

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Object Detail Id : Primary key of this table.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: STANDARD_OBJECT_DETAIL_TABLE
columns.description: Used to save the new Partitioned interface table

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: IMPORT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the parent Import Object table.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Object Name for the row which willbe displayed on the mapping

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAIL_TABLE
columns.description: Object Detail Table - Table name of the driving table that the VO is based on

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAIL_VO
columns.description: Object Detail VO - Name of the VO that this row  is referring to.

columns.name: PARENT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Reference to the parent object detail id for VO hierarchy.

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_INSTANCE_NAME
columns.description: View Object Instance Name : Name of the instance of the view object in the AM

columns.name: VIEW_ACCESSOR_NAME
columns.description: View accessor name to access the interface child rows

columns.name: BASE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Extensible base table name which saves the basetable for the object

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAIL_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate Key for object detail

columns.name: SOURCE_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Source File Name to be used to hold the file name used to pass the data for this object while using file import

columns.name: TXN_VO_INSTANCE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction VO Instance Name available in the base Am

columns.name: TXN_VO_ACCESSOR_NAME
columns.description: Transaction VO accessor Name used to access the child rows from parent

columns.name: TXN_VO_NAME
columns.description: TXN_VO_NAME which indicates the name of the vo at txn side

columns.name: TXN_VO_PRIMARY_KEY_ATTR
columns.description: Transaction VO Primary Key attribute name to be used for ADF import flow

columns.name: AK_VIEW_OBJECT_INSTANCE_NAME
columns.description: The column holds the view object instance names for the ADF Import

columns.name: AK_VIEW_ACCESSOR_NAME
columns.description: Column holds the ViewAccessor Name to get the Chid Rows from the Parent for the ADF Import

columns.name: OBJECT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Column used to determine whether the ImportVO registered is a secondary import vo or not. If the object is a Secondary ImportVO then value of this column will be "SECONDARY"

columns.name: RECURSIVE_IMP_VO_ACCESSOR_NAME
columns.description: View link accessor name on the interface side of the recursive objects.

columns.name: RECURSIVE_SUPPORT
columns.description: This column specifies whether the object can recurse on itself or not.

columns.name: SRC_VIEW_CRITERIA
columns.description: View criteria to filter out only the first level records in the hierarchy.

columns.name: RECURSIVE_TXN_VO_ACCESSOR_NAME
columns.description: View link accessor name on the destination side of the recursive objects.

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates whether object should be hidden from classic interface

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
